program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bar-cols (filter (lambda (c)
                                      (for/or ((r (range 0 h))) (!= (at g r c) 7)))
                                    (range 0 w)))
                  (n (length bar-cols))
                  (bar-info (map (lambda (c)
                                   (let* ((top (find-first (lambda (r)
                                                             (!= (at g r c) 7))
                                                           (range 0 h)))
                                          (color (at g top c))
                                          (ht (- h top)))
                                     (list c color ht)))
                                 bar-cols))
                  (colors (map second bar-info))
                  (heights (map third bar-info))
                  (new-colors (append (list (last colors))
                                      (reverse (cdr (reverse colors)))))
                  (new-heights (append (cdr heights) (list (first heights)))))
             (reduce (lambda (acc i)
                       (let* ((c (nth bar-cols i))
                              (ht (nth new-heights i))
                              (col (nth new-colors i)))
                         (reduce (lambda (g2 r) (set-cell g2 r c col))
                                 acc
                                 (range (- h ht) h))))
                     (empty-grid h w 7)
                     (range 0 n))))))
